integrity: Proof supplied with explicit scalar recurrence, Cauchy subordination, logarithmic potential, integrability and between-observation envelope; numerical checks are supporting. Priority conditional upon broader historical literature assessment.
scientific_limitations: Centered symmetric strictly stable driving noise only, 0<index<=1; fixed deterministic sampling gap, linear scalar drift, feedback only in the noise coefficient. No claims about skewed noise, drift feedback, vector models, or moment stability. The analytical infinite-time proof is not replaced by finite numerical tests.
title: A Cauchy-mixture obstruction to stabilizing scalar flows by sampled stable-noise feedback
